title: Idioms: Everyday Talk
ringkas: break the ice, on the same page, in a nutshell, hit the road
goals: memahami **idiom menengah** yang sering muncul dalam percakapan
mengetahui bahwa idiom **kurang cocok untuk tulisan resmi**

lesson.text: Di tingkat dasar kamu mempelajari idiom seperti *a piece of cake*. Kini idiom menengah: ungkapan yang sering dipakai di kantor, sekolah, dan pergaulan. Pakai seperlunya dan pada situasi tidak resmi.

items.ex: He told a joke to break the ice.
Let's make sure we are on the same page.
In a nutshell, the plan failed.
She always goes the extra mile for customers.
Let's get the ball rolling.
Keep an eye on the baby.

items.en: hit the nail on the head
items.ex: You hit the nail on the head.
Don't be afraid to speak your mind.
It's late; we should hit the road.
I burned the midnight oil to finish the report.
I'm always on the go.

items.id: lebih baik terlambat daripada tidak sama sekali
items.ex: Better late than never!
Saving money pays off in the long run.
He finished at the last minute.
Let's settle this once and for all.
I visit him every now and then.
That car costs a fortune.
It is hard to make ends meet.
Save for a rainy day.
His hard work paid off.
I had to bite the bullet and apologise.
We are back to square one.
Everyone wants a piece of the pie.
The new plan worked like a charm.

lines.en: Let's get the ball rolling. In a nutshell, we need a new plan.
lines.id: Ayo mulai. Singkatnya, kita butuh rencana baru.

lines.en: I think we are on the same page.
Good. Please go the extra mile on this one.
lines.id: Bagus. Tolong berusaha lebih keras untuk yang satu ini.

lines.en: Of course. It will pay off in the long run.
lines.id: Tentu. Hasilnya akan terasa dalam jangka panjang.

lesson.title: Cara menghafal
lesson.text: Tulis satu kalimat sendiri untuk tiap idiom yang kamu hafal, lalu pakai dalam percakapan sungguhan dengan teman atau di catatan harianmu.

items: Berbicara dan bekerja sama: [[break the ice]], [[on the same page]], [[in a nutshell]], [[go the extra mile]], [[get the ball rolling]], [[keep an eye on]].
Waktu dan kebiasaan: [[hit the road]], [[burn the midnight oil]], [[on the go]], [[better late than never]], [[in the long run]], [[at the last minute]].
Uang dan usaha: [[cost a fortune]], [[make ends meet]], [[save for a rainy day]], [[pay off]], [[bite the bullet]], [[back to square one]].
